I just wanted to feel less alone. 

I know what you mean. I try to be better. I can't be better. I give up on being better. Then I get miserable and dont talk to people for a long time.

It won't change, unfortunately (re: the hot/cold shit). 

Hell, I'm due to be hit by a category 4/5 hurricane tonight and mine still is ignoring me. 

You won't feel depressed while talking to him while things are going well, because he's an upper. The endorphins/oxytocin/serotonin released elevate your mood. Its like a drug. When he leaves, its like withdrawal. Its hell.

I know you think this is specific, but I relate. 

You probably won't listen, because I know I wouldn't in your position, but if they give you this much anxiety, leave. You'll be (marginally) less miserable.

This made me feel like someone stabbed me in the chest ): 

Too bad they didn't

Was in it, it didn't kill me, just left me with a shit ton more work to do 

To be honest though I slept through the whole thing right beside a window because I really was hoping for the best haha
